data.body: DESIGN DECISION (operator-ratified 2026-08-22): implement the reconciler outbound-comment invariant check — every successfully posted Jira comment must have its returned comment ID recorded locally; divergence (post succeeded, local comment_ids unchanged) raises a bridge alert. Alert firing is DEBOUNCED ACROSS 2 CONSECUTIVE RECONCILE PASSES: it fires only when the same divergence is observed in 2 consecutive passes, matching the N-of-M alarm philosophy of the voter-observability lane. NOT per-pass immediate firing. This adjudicates the first acceptance criterion (per-pass vs debounced): debounced, N=2 consecutive.
